title: Opening of the tape, full name and birth date
summary: Dick Allen announces the recording at Tulane's library; Mazzari gives his full name, Rodolfo Mario Giuseppe Mazzari, the date (6 November 1959) and his birth on 25 March 1917.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: This is a tape being recorded in the Howard Tilton Memorial Library Tulane University Seminar Room 2 and my name is Dick Allen what's yours? Marusi Mazzari. What's your full name?

Well it is... Alright, you don't want to give it... The real name you mean? Yeah. Well the real name is Rodolfo Mario Giuseppe Mazzari and with a name like that I was born on East 33rd Street. Yeah. So what's today's date? Today is the 6th I believe.
March 25th, 1917. And where exactly you said?
